D: Two teenage nerds use a computer to create their dream woman, and their weekend goes wild.
P: Serve the snacks when the house party kicks off at Wyatt's place.
S: Bread bowl baked with cream cheese, sour cream, bacon and cheddar dip
A hollowed cob loaf filled with hot cheese, bacon and onion dip, with the torn bread for dunking.
Salt and vinegar chips with onion dip

Potatoes sliced paper thin, soaked in vinegar, fried until crisp and tossed with salt and malt vinegar, with a creamy French onion and chive dip. Slice 4 large potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and soak in 500ml water with 200ml white vinegar for 30 minutes. Dry very well on tea towels. Fry in small batches at 170C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp. Toss with flaky salt and a sprinkle of malt vinegar. Mix 250g sour cream with half a packet of French onion soup mix and chopped chives for the dip.
Crispy baked wings in hot sauce butter with blue cheese dip
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, blue cheese dip.
M: Thin pizza with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms, cut in squares

Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with oregano, mozzarella, pepperoni and mushroom, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, sliced and left in the box on the bench. Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, then scatter grated mozzarella, pepperoni and sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the highest oven heat for 7 to 10 minutes. Slice and leave in a box on the bench.
the Chicago suburbs where it all happens

Beef topside roasted rare, sliced paper thin and dunked in garlic and oregano beef jus, piled into soft rolls with hot pickled giardiniera. Rub 1kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and 1 tsp oregano and roast at 200C for 35 minutes to rare. Rest, chill for an hour and slice paper thin. Simmer 1L beef stock with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 15 minutes. Dip the beef in the jus for 1 minute, pile into 4 split long rolls, spoon over more jus and top with giardiniera.
W: Big brother Chet's party sheet cake
Chocolate sheet cake covered in fudge frosting

Chocolate cake baked in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes, cooled, spread thickly with fudge frosting and covered in sprinkles, cut into big squares straight from the tray. Beat 200g butter with 300g sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 300g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake in a lined tray at 175C for 30 minutes and cool. Spread with fudge frosting of butter, icing sugar and cocoa, then cover with sprinkles.
K: Bourbon, muddled lemon and mint shaken hard over ice

Bourbon muddled with lemon wedges, mint and sugar syrup, shaken with ice and poured over crushed ice with a mint sprig on top. Dissolve 60g sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. For each drink, muddle half a lemon cut into wedges with 4 mint leaves and 15ml of the syrup in a shaker. Add 50ml bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Pour everything into a short glass and top with crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig.

s.note: Bread bowl baked with cream cheese, sour cream, bacon and cheddar dip
s.how: Hollow out 1 cob loaf, keeping the lid. Mix 250g cream cheese, 300ml sour cream, 150g diced fried bacon, 150g grated cheddar and 1 packet French onion soup mix. Fill the loaf, wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Tear the hollowed bread into chunks for dipping.
